title: Hamzat al-wasl: starting well: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-Qiyamah, hamzat al-wasl and alif-lam
source: Written for quran/y9 lesson 5 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Hamzat al-wasl rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 5. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

head: If you start at
Say
rows: if started: ittabi' (kasrah: 3rd letter has kasrah)

keywords.def: a joining hamza: said only when we start with it, dropped when joined

questions.q: How do you start the word «ٱتَّبِعْ» (as in 75:18) if you begin with it?
questions.a: ittabi': the third letter ب has a kasrah, so start with kasrah.

questions.q: Starting drill (pupil PDF): write how to start each of eight words with hamzat al-wasl from Al-Qiyamah, Al-Muddaththir and Al-A'la. Today's rota group recites 75:20 to 30.
questions.a: Answers on the teacher sheet (al- words with fathah; verbs by the third letter; ism with kasrah).

questions.q: Extend: why does the alif of «بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ» disappear in reading?
questions.a: Hamzat al-wasl is dropped when joined; the laam of بَلْ takes a kasrah to join.

questions.q: Stretch: name three special nouns that start with hamzat al-wasl.
questions.a: ٱسْم، ٱبْن، ٱمْرِئ (also ٱبْنَة، ٱمْرَأَة، ٱثْنَان، ٱثْنَتَان).
A) idh-hab. Verb; the third letter ه has a fathah, so we start with kasrah: idh-hab.

questions.q: Think again: You stop after 'كَلَّا' in 75:20 and want to restart at 'بَلْ'. Easy. But what if a word starts with ٱ? How do you start?
questions.a: Hamzat al-wasl is said when starting: with fathah in al-, and with kasrah or dammah in verbs depending on the third letter.
